evidence_citations.note: final stage FROM debian:bookworm-slim copies only /usr/local/bin/hello-autotools from the build stage and declares ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/hello-autotools"]; the image runs the binary and exits, it does not start a listening process

operational_notes: The image's ENTRYPOINT runs the built binary directly and exits when it returns; there is no supervisor, no restart policy and no long-running process declared anywhere in the repository.
No environment variables, volumes or configuration files are declared for the final-stage image; the binary takes no runtime inputs beyond argv.
coverage_gaps: No ports are exposed or declared anywhere in the repository (no EXPOSE, no docker-compose.yaml, no k8s manifest); this record cannot confirm the binary never opens a socket at runtime, only that none is declared.

No orchestration, deployment or IaC manifests exist anywhere in the repository (repository-partition-map coverage.category_checks: iac and deployment both not-found, confirmed again at this revision); there is exactly one service to place because none is declared to run alongside it.
No logging, metrics or health-check configuration is declared anywhere in the repository; operational observability for this image is entirely unaddressed.
